packageRules.description: Minor and patch bumps carry themselves: npm test, bun test and the binary build all run on the PR, and a green run is the whole review. Majors are excluded here and handled below.

Majors stay manual. The @types/node 24 to 26 bump needed a source change (assert.match stopped taking an optional message), which is exactly the class of break a green-tick automerge would have hidden until the next unrelated PR.

The engines floor is a decision, not a version to chase. '>=24' is where node:sqlite became stable, and it is deliberately below the one version the tree is developed against; mise.toml carries that pin and Renovate may move it.
A new direct dependency is CLAUDE.md section 4 territory, so the rule that matters is that there are none to update. Grouped and never automerged so that a PR touching this line is conspicuous.

hostRules.description: Version lookups go to the public registry; the Takumi Guard proxy is an install-path concern and anonymous mode has no token to give Renovate. If the proxy serves metadata fine, this block can go.
